detail.aiMemoryDesc: Start a new conversation, and previous context carries over. Beronica remembers your work style, preferences, and project states — no re-explaining needed.
detail.gtdInboxDesc: Just say what's on your mind. AI instantly captures it to your inbox and auto-classifies into Projects, Areas, or Resources. No more manual sorting stress.
detail.dailyReviewDesc: Every morning, AI suggests your top 3 priorities. Personalized recommendations based on deadlines, priorities, and your energy levels.
detail.paraStructureDesc: Projects, Areas, Resources, Archive — everything automatically finds its place. AI operates Tiago Forte's PARA methodology in real-time.
detail.weeklyReviewDesc: Friday evening, AI wraps up your week. Completed/pending project status, next week's key tasks, and insights — all at a glance.
detail.contactMgmtDesc: People mentioned in conversations are automatically tracked. AI remembers who you talked to, when, and about what — maintaining relationship context.
detail.localPrivacyDesc: All data is stored as markdown files in your Obsidian Vault. No cloud lock-in — complete data ownership guaranteed.

faq.q1: Can I use this even if I'm not a developer?
faq.a1: Yes. Once you follow the initial setup guide, everything after that is done through chat. No coding knowledge required.
faq.q2: Why is Claude Code CLI required?
faq.a2: Claude Code CLI is the essential tool that allows AI to directly create/move/modify files. The Claudian plugin uses it to automatically manage your vault.
faq.q3: Do I have to fill in all the files?
faq.a3: No. The auto setup prompt creates the basic files, and content gets filled in gradually as you chat with AI. It doesn't need to be perfect from the start.
faq.a4: Possible but not recommended. CLAUDE.md references this path, so you'd need to update CLAUDE.md as well if you change it.
faq.q5: Can I share the vault with team members?
faq.a5: The vault is designed for personal use. Since _me/ contains personal information, we recommend sharing only specific folders like 30_Resources/ for team collaboration.
